provider.label: inside a plan the owner has (the provider's official command-line tool or API key)

own_harness.label: an open harness with a local model

embedded.label: AI that already lives inside an application

single.label: one machine works and the others stay unused

director_workers.label: one strong machine directs and the others execute

peers.label: all equal, each takes what falls to it

chain.label: in a chain: the work passes from one machine to the next in order

propose_only.label: the agent only proposes; you decide every step

routine_alone.label: the agent does routine reading alone and asks about the rest

alone_inside_limits.label: the agent decides alone inside the limits; every write still asks for your permission

also_night.label: also at night, without you present

app.label: the AI of an installed application
